title: 1. Scan eight tasks for failures of seedless generation plus search
hypothesis: Task-specific contact and articulation requirements will expose failures of the unchanged seedless controller generator that are absent on reach-v2.

prediction.against: baseline: reach-v2 arm within this scan
prediction.rationale: Predict that at least one of the seven non-reach tasks scores at least 0.20 below reach-v2 on untouched development cases 10–39; this identifies a substantial deficit rather than another ceiling.

code_changes: scripts/compare_generation_modes.py (--research-mode task-scan: per task one single-phase structure, 24-candidate independent search on 5 probe cases, winner on 30 disjoint confirmation cases from the same fresh pool)

falsified_by: No non-reach task scores at least 0.20 below reach-v2. One generated structure per task makes this reconnaissance, not evidence that a task is intrinsically difficult.

approval.note: approved by advisor gpt-6.1-sol (consult call_00037, 'revise' with changes applied) under the user's 2026-10-22 session delegation

controls.note: control is the reach-v2 arm of this scan; the prediction asks whether any other task's confirmation success is at least 0.20 lower

result.notes: Eight tasks, one gpt-6.1-sol single-phase structure each (all valid first time, 8 calls), 24-candidate independent rollout search on 5 probe cases and the winner on 30 disjoint fresh confirmation cases from the same pool (seeds 2612-2619). Every task's winner scored 1.00 on confirmation; untrained (step 0) probe success was 1.0 on six tasks, 0.8 on door-open-v2 and 0.2 on button-press-v2, and 11-24 of the 24 candidates succeeded on each probe. No task fell 0.20 below reach-v2: refuted. One structure per task, so this is reconnaissance; but with push-v2 (D-014) and pick-place-v2 (D-016..D-018), the single-phase recipe has now solved every MetaWorld task with a schema in this codebase. 1200 episodes (960 probe + 240 confirmation).

verdicts.reasoning: No non-reach task scored 0.20 below reach-v2: all eight tasks' searched winners reached 1.00 on 30 fresh confirmation cases, so the predicted failure did not appear. Untrained, six structures already succeeded fully; button-press (0.2) and door-open (0.8) were lifted to 1.0 by 24-candidate search, with 11-24 of 24 candidates succeeding on each probe. One structure per task makes this reconnaissance, not a ranking, but no weakness was found.
verdicts.next_experiment: The single-phase + search recipe saturates every schema-supported MetaWorld task; further method comparisons need harder tasks (e.g. assembly, peg-insert, multi-object) which need new observation schemas and prompt assets, or a stricter success criterion. R-023's predeclared rule says skip it (no task below 0.80).

verdicts.reasoning: The named reach-v2 control and all seven non-reach arms scored 1.00 on confirmation [logs/research/task_scan_s2600/summary.json]. The largest decrease in promotion_success_rate relative to reach-v2 was 0.00, below the predicted 0.20 threshold [logs/research/task_scan_s2600/summary.json]. Thus, no scanned task exhibited the required deficit, directly satisfying the approved falsification condition [logs/research/task_scan_s2600/summary.json]. This refutes the scan prediction, not a general claim about task difficulty or generation reliability, because only one generated structure per task was tested [logs/research/task_scan_s2600/summary.json].
